environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on EKS cluster (namespace: prod-workflows). Pod runs with annotated service account for IRSA (IAM Roles for Service Accounts) with projected token volume. Kubernetes NetworkPolicy applied to namespace with spec.egress rules: allows TCP 443 to 0.0.0.0/0 CIDR but includes a deny-all rule for 169.254.169.254/32 on all ports via a Calico GlobalNetworkPolicy with order:100. The pod's IRSA annotation maps to role arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/workflow-executor-role which has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/NoMetadataAccess) that denies ec2:DescribeInstances. Session cookies configured with SameSite=None for cross-origin compatibility. No CSRF middleware applied at application layer.

config.network_policy: Calico GlobalNetworkPolicy order:100 deny egress to 169.254.169.254/32
config.iam_method: IRSA with projected service account token
